note:
Reviewed ship quantities for the isolated Hatteras–Alabama engagement: one vessel on each side, Hatteras lost and Alabama surviving. The distant Union blockading squadron and the later arrival of Brooklyn are excluded. Ship losses drive the animation; human deaths and wounds remain separate evidence. No claim is made that the vessels had equal tonnage, firepower or crews.

Equipment review: Hatteras is represented by a rigged sidewheel gunboat; Alabama by the screw-sloop family. These are mechanism and equipment analogies, not exact hull reconstructions.
